fullHistory.content:
Hey! I'm Roba Copilot — your co-pilot for the Unitree G1. Here’s what we can do together:

🤖 Poses  
"Make the robot wave its right arm."  
"Show the robot take a balanced stepping pose."  
"Put the robot in a friendly T‑pose."

✋ Hands  
"Open both hands wide like a greeting."  
"Close the left hand into a fist."  
"Flex the right hand fingers to point."
